_doc: Statuses a hit can put on a monster (Enemies.apply_status). A skill lists them in skills.<id>.on_hit (upgrades_<class>.json) with from = the skill level that adds it and the numbers: time (s), mul (slow: speed x; shock: x hit damage per jump), dps_mul (bleed / burn: x hit damage per second, ticks every 0.5 s, credited to the skill), time (shock: how long the mark lasts; a later shock hit arcs to every marked monster for mul x hit, capped under 0.5; chain / radius = item Lôi xích arcs to the nearest instead). sprite = Sprite Lab status sprite drawn on the monster, scaled to its body radius (made for radius 8 px): at body (body centre) or head (on top of the body). freeze also stops the monster animation. tint = colour laid over the monster while it lasts. tile: drawn as several sprites at the game's whole sprite scale spread over a big body instead of one sprite blown up (user 2026-11-20: burn blurry on big monsters). alpha: opacity the status is drawn with, so the monster under it stays visible (user 2026-11-20). Non-tiled statuses scale by a whole number only. priority / max_shown: at most max_shown statuses are drawn on one monster, highest priority first; the rest still act (review 2026-11-21: stacked layers cluttered big fights). holy_mark (Ánh sáng, design/species.md): contact damage x contact_mul, Linh hồn speed x spirit_speed_mul; when it ends a burst of burst_mul x the marking hit within burst_radius (burst_sprite). corrode (Bóng tối): each stack (up to max_stacks, re-applying adds one and refreshes time) makes the monster take +per_stack damage; dying with burst_at stacks or more bursts within burst_radius and gives one stack to each monster there. at: body | head | feet.

stun.name: Choáng
stun.desc: Quái đứng yên và không gây sát thương khi chạm.

freeze.name: Đóng băng
freeze.desc: Quái bị nhốt trong khối băng: đứng hình, không gây sát thương khi chạm.

burn.name: Bỏng
burn.desc: Quái cháy, mất máu mỗi 0,5 giây.

shock.name: Giật điện
shock.desc: Quái mang dấu giật điện; mỗi đòn giật sau lan sang mọi quái còn mang dấu (dưới nửa sát thương).

holy_mark.name: Thánh ấn
holy_mark.desc: Quái bị chói: sát thương chạm giảm, Linh hồn bị làm chậm; hết ấn thì nổ sáng.

corrode.name: Ăn mòn
corrode.desc: Mỗi tầng quái nhận thêm sát thương; chết khi đủ tầng thì nổ bóng, lan Ăn mòn sang quái gần.
